repair.title: More Births Had Skilled Care
repair.summary: WHO data shows births attended by skilled health personnel rose from 61 percent in 2000 to 87 percent in 2025.
repair.why_it_matters: Trained care during childbirth is one of the practical ways health systems keep mothers and newborns alive.
repair.caveat: Attendance does not prove care quality, and access remains uneven.
